name: Sidechain-compressor duck synth/pad group to kick
goal: Make space for a four-on-the-floor kick by sidechain-compressing a synth/pad bus from the kick: insert compressor before reverb on the group, enable external sidechain from kick, use strong ratio (~6:1), fast attack, slower release, and tune threshold so pads pump without wrecking the mix.

source.title: Sidechain Synthesizers (and any other instruments, also called the sidechain effect or ducking)

prerequisites: DAW compressor with external/sidechain input; grouped synth/pad bus; kick track

inputs.name: kick_track
inputs.description: Four-on-floor or pulsed kick used as key

outputs.name: ducked_synth_bus
outputs.description: Sidechain-compressed synth group with kick space

constraints: Ground every step in the source YouTube-provided Show-transcript text; do not invent UI paths or numeric settings not stated there.

Original synthesis / signal-flow only — map brand UI (Serum/Vital/Ableton/etc.) to portable osc/filter/env/LFO/FX modules for Traveler-inspired or Web Audio hybrid; never rip presets, wavetables, or samples.
Prefer transferable parameter relationships over vendor-specific preset or bank names.
Sidechain here means using one signal’s amplitude to control compression on another (ducking)—not a genre rule.

steps.action: Identify dense synth/pad stacks competing with a loud kick on beats 1–2–3–4. Goal: duck those instruments each kick hit to open mix space.

Group the synth waves onto one bus. Insert a compressor on that group *before* reverb (optional HP on the bus to clear mud). Plain compression without sidechain just thickens—enable sidechain instead.
Turn on compressor sidechain / external key; set audio-from to the kick track so compression engages when the kick hits.

Set a strong starting ratio (~6:1). Use a very fast attack so the duck grabs with the kick; start with a slower release so the pad swells back between hits (adjust to taste; exaggerated settings teach the effect).
steps.expect: Audible pump in time with kick

steps.action: Tune threshold (and makeup if needed) so ducking makes kick space without squashing musicality; A/B bypass to confirm clearer kick and breathing pads.
steps.expect: Kick punches; pads recover between hits

verification: Gain reduction meters pulse with kick, not constantly
Bypass comparison shows more kick clarity with sidechain on
Compressor sits before reverb on the synth group
